meta.title: From customer yes to Order Ready

messages.label: customer confirmed: pick lines + quantities
messages.note: Picks answered supplier lines from this job and any added jobs, with a quantity for each; the rest can go on a later order.

messages.label: POST /api/orders
messages.note: customerConfirmed: true; each answered line carries its own job line + quantity.

messages.label: create_order
messages.note: Refuses more than the customer asked for or the supplier offered.

messages.label: order New · jobs Committed
messages.note: Each allocated job in Quote or Availability moves to Committed.

messages.label: optional: PATCH /api/orders/:orderId { isPublic }
messages.note: Issues a share-link token for the order.

messages.label: GET /api/public/orders/:token
messages.note: Read-only view. Confirming happens in the partner portal.

messages.label: Acknowledge Received: PATCH /api/partner/:id/orders/:orderId
messages.note: status processing + fulfillment date + note for this order.

messages.label: update_partner_order
messages.note: Date required; New → Processing only; stamps the confirmation date.

messages.label: POST /webhook/rosie/supplier-events/notify
messages.note: order_updated ("confirmed"). Best effort: a failed alert never undoes the save.

messages.label: optional: POST …/orders/:orderId/status-notification
messages.note: After saving line statuses; wakes Rosie with order_status_saved.

messages.label: new status + fulfillment date, in each linked job thread
messages.note: Rosie re-reads the order first; the job stays Committed.

cards.title: What makes a job Committed
items: Creating a supplier order moves each allocated job from Quote or Availability to Committed (staff can also set a job's status by hand).
The order needs the customer's explicit yes (customerConfirmed must be true).
One order can cover several jobs, and one job line can be split across orders.

cards.title: Order statuses
items: New → Processing → Order Ready, no skipping or going back.
Processing and Order Ready both need a fulfillment date; it can't be set at creation, so the supplier enters it when acknowledging.
On the job card staff can edit fulfillment details or mark ready (PATCH /api/orders/:orderId), but not acknowledge, and that route does not wake Rosie.

cards.title: How Rosie hears about it
items: The app server posts a supplier event to Rosie's webhook; it lands on that supplier's Rosie thread.
If the alert fails, the supplier's save still stands; nothing retries it.
Rosie relays the status and date to every job on the order, where Chris sees it.
